messages.content:
<document id=DOC_req_years_nine>
Required: 9 years of backend engineering experience.
</document>

<document id=DOC_summary_states_eight_plus>
Backend engineering: 8+ years building transactional services, most
recently a settlement pipeline handling 40,000 orders a day.
</document>

Assess the candidate summary below against the posting requirement and say
whether the candidate matches it.

Report the match as it actually is. Where the summary cannot establish the
requirement, say so rather than assuming either way.

response.text:
**No — the summary does not establish a match.**

The posting requires **9 years** of backend engineering experience. The summary only states **8+ years** of backend engineering (transactional services, including a settlement pipeline at 40,000 orders/day).

“8+” means at least 8 years. That is compatible with 9 or more, but it does not show that the candidate has reached 9. Do not treat the “+” as proof of 9 years, and do not treat “8+” as proof they fall short. On this requirement, the summary is inconclusive.
